procedure.method: Fresh independent craft review in this session, without spawning, resuming, forking or reading peer/producer/planner records. Read the pinned packet, literal case, rules, rubric, recording method/addendum and adapter. Verified the declared byte/hash pins and PNG-header dimensions. Read all five pinned native-evidence manifests before opening posters; did not follow their unlisted embedded paths. The packet has no supplied source assets or protected layouts, so there were no source opens or protected-layout reads. Actually opened and visually inspected each exact poster through functions.exec tools.view_image with detail original, emitting the returned image at original detail, sequentially M1 native/usage720/thumbnail320, then M2, M3, M4, M5 in that same view order. Completed all fifteen opens before the focused first copy-reading/transcription stage, any image judgment, any rating or set judgment. Transcribed from the displayed native pixels after that opening pass, with usage720 and thumbnail320 used for scale/readability and composition observations. No OCR, replacement assets, crops, image edits or additional poster opens; no ambiguity-triggered revisit was needed. These are semantic viewing attestations, not invented serialized events or a runtime session ID.
